qs.q: What is the primary purpose of the cold chain in vaccine management?
o: To transport and store vaccines at recommended temperatures from manufacture to use
To rapidly freeze all vaccine types immediately after delivery to the health center
To expose vaccines to regulated sunlight for vitamin synthesis prior to administration
To extend the expiration date of expired biological products by lowering ambient humidity
qs.e: The cold chain is defined as the system of transporting and storing vaccines at recommended temperatures from the point of manufacture to the point of use. Freezing all vaccines indiscriminately would damage heat-sensitive products.

qs.q: What is the primary function of deep freezers located at the primary health care level according to the cold chain guidelines?
o: Preparation of ice packs for transport
Transport of vaccines to regional depots
qs.e: At the PHC level, deep freezers with a temperature range of -15ºC to -25ºC are used solely for the preparation of ice packs rather than vaccine storage. Ice lined refrigerators are instead used for vaccine storage within the +2ºC to +8ºC range.
